description: Privileged access to Zen's Space and tab internals.

functions.name: describe
functions.description: Report versions and which Zen internals this build actually exposes.

functions.name: snapshot
functions.description: Enumerate every window, Space, and tab, including tabs in Spaces that are not visible and tabs that have not been loaded.

functions.name: openTab
functions.description: Open a tab in the background, optionally routed into an explicit Space. Never selects the tab or switches the visible Space.

functions.name: moveTab
functions.description: Route an existing tab into an explicit Space. Preserves the tab's identifier and does not switch the visible Space.

functions.name: navigateTab
functions.description: Navigate the tab with this identifier. Does not select it.

functions.name: closeTab
functions.description: Close the tab with this identifier.

events.name: onChanged
events.description: Fires when tabs change. Advisory only: a client that misses one must reconcile with a fresh snapshot.
